description:
Time really does feel faster every year — and it's not the clock that changed. Here's the real reason your years are shrinking, and the simple hack that stretches them back.

Chapters:
0:00 One year = 10% of your life
0:10 Why the feeling is real
0:22 The simple math of shrinking years
0:37 Your brain counts memories, not minutes
1:01 The holiday paradox
1:27 Why novelty stretches time
1:51 Why childhood felt so long
2:04 The simple hack
2:26 Change the footage

My honest take: this one genuinely changed how I plan my weeks. A boring week doesn't just feel short — it leaves nothing behind. Chasing one new thing a week is the cheapest time machine there is.
